_comment: Johto spot overrides (notable-spots spec, authored overrides). add: {map, x, y, facing (DIR_*), kind: bench | center_side}. drop: {map, kind} drops a whole detected place; {map, x, y[, kind]} drops one spot. ignore_objects: {map, local_id} objects the walker graph treats as passable (story blockers the simulation outlives).

ignore_objects.what: Rocket at the Azalea Gym door
ignore_objects.why: Story blocker on the Gym door's only approach tile, present at New Game. The Gym's own leader is home-locked until the player holds the badge, which needs this blocker gone, so the static walker graph treats it as passable.

ignore_objects.why: Story gate on the only way from Ecruteak to the Bell Tower: he steps aside (FLAG_HIDE_TINTOWER_GUARD) once the player brings the Clear Bell. Morty's Bell Tower favourite is a place a notable already visits, so the static walker graph treats the sage as passable.

drop.why: Shelves and a clerk, but not somewhere to stock up; it is a named spot.
